SELECT id,display_name,brand,packaging,ean,category_id,category_name,category_ids,unit_price,price_format,price_per_unit,price_per_unit_unit,available,published,synced_at,regions,regional_prices,promo_base_price,offer_zones,raw,md5(to_jsonb(p)::text) AS source_row_md5 FROM public.consum_products p WHERE (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)|b[ií]fidus'))
      AND NOT (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)'))
      AND id COLLATE "C" > '' COLLATE "C" ORDER BY id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 100
